blind_spots.blind_spot: No integration or compliance ownership story for a component destined for DoD ground-station/satellite networks
blind_spots.operator_reality: A beam-steering module sold into a space-imaging program still has to cross an ATO/RMF boundary once it's part of a fielded satellite ground segment; a component vendor with no stated integration or accreditation role risks being the piece a prime can't get certified in time.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The company's entire public identity is a patented mechanism (the magnetic joint) sold as a component, not a fielded system — the site never discusses what happens after the demo.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Light Steering Technologies, Inc. is seeking to advance its patented technology which has the potential to enable a major advancement in beam steering for space imaging applications.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Spec sheet is all lab-bench precision metrics, none about on-orbit survivability or sustainment
blind_spots.operator_reality: Dither and settle-time numbers matter on an optical bench; they say nothing about radiation tolerance, thermal cycling, or what happens when the mechanism needs a fix after launch — the actual failure mode for space hardware that never gets a second chance at the field.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Marketing content is written to sell the patent's precision to engineers evaluating the mechanism, not to answer a program manager's sustainment questions.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Dither 13 µrad 60° Step and settle time 0.5 s Weight 25 kg baseline w/o light weighting

blind_spots.blind_spot: Company is a 6-7 person team running three parallel defense product lines with a demo that's now three years old
blind_spots.operator_reality: Metrology, laser communications, laser processing, and space imaging each need their own acquisition advocacy chain and integration path; a team this small spread this thin is the classic setup where the funded months run out on all four before any one of them transitions to a program of record.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The site presents all four verticals as equally live product lines without signaling which one is actually closest to fielding, suggesting the company itself hasn't prioritized.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Light Steering Technologies was awarded a contract by Elbit Systems of America to demonstrate capabilities of Multi-Axis Scanner technology for low cost line-of-sight stabilization applications

opener_hook: AFWERX funded your beam-steering Direct-to-Phase II at $1.25M for laser comms while the Elbit demonstration contract for the same Multi-Axis Scanner platform is now three years old.
what_they_do: Builds a patented magnetic-joint beam-steering mechanism (Multi-Axis Scanner) for space imaging, laser communications, and metrology applications, sold as a component to defense and commercial integrators.
